label: CBASS system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a cyclic-oligonucleotide-based anti-phage signaling locus whose oligonucleotide cyclase produces cyclic oligonucleotide signals during phage infection that activate an effector to inhibit bacteriophage replication.
exact_synonyms: cyclic-oligonucleotide-based anti-phage signalling system|cyclic-oligonucleotide-based anti-phage signaling system
observations: Cyclic-oligonucleotide-signaling branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual CD-NTase, CapV, SAVED, TIR, HORMA, and JAB genes or proteins, cyclic oligonucleotides as chemical entities, individual source rows naming one candidate CBASS locus, cGAS-STING as a broader family, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, restriction-modification, CRISPR-Cas, and phosphorothioate defense.
